Site Kit turns a repo into a verified project website

Connect your open source repository and pay a one-time setup fee. An agent reads the repository and produces a structured content file covering features, roadmap, figures, screenshots, documentation, pricing and legal text. A fixed template renders that content, and an independent verifier checks every factual claim against the repository before anything publishes. Nothing appears on the live site unless it traces back to a specific commit and path, so what the site says about your project stays true even as the code moves on. This paragraph alone is long enough that a reader without JavaScript still sees a real explanation rather than an empty shell and a spinner.
